MT370.TITLE: MT-370 Series
MT370.DESCRIPTION: Perfect for mid-scale construction tasks, this mixer offers a 370L drum with 360° rotation for flexible loading and versatile discharge postions. Its tubular T-reinforced chassis and optimized drum vanes ensure efficient mixing and extended durability. A V-belt transmission minimizes vibration, while pedal-controlled positioning and cast iron-toothed parts simplify single-operator use. Built from highly resistant steel, the MT-370 stands up to continuous mixing demands on every worksite.

HERO.TITLE: Concrete mixers manufactured in Panama since 2002
HERO.DESCRIPTION: MT-370 and MT-480 mixers are designed, assembled and supported in Panama. No imports, no duties, no months of waiting — stock on hand, local technical support, nationwide delivery.

MFG.TITLE: A Panamanian company serving the national construction industry
MFG.LEAD: Llanotecnica has manufactured industrial equipment in Panama since 2002 — over two decades serving contractors, construction firms and public works companies across the country.
MFG.P1: Our facilities in Pacora produce, assemble and test every mixer before delivery. Every unit ships with quality control by a Panamanian team that understands local market demands: humidity, extreme climates, long shifts, intensive jobs.
MFG.P2: As a national manufacturer, we don't depend on import chains or inventories on the other side of the world. When a customer needs a unit, a part or technical support, we respond from here.
MFG.BULLET1_DESC: Continuous operation since 2002, with mixers deployed on projects throughout the isthmus.
MFG.BULLET2_DESC: Components and finishes selected to withstand humidity, dust, coastal salt and intensive use.
MFG.BULLET3_DESC: Local engineering, parts in inventory and direct attention — no middlemen, no international response times.
MFG.IMAGE_ALT: Llanotecnica team at its manufacturing facility in Pacora, Panama

WHY.TITLE: The advantages of buying from a Panamanian manufacturer
WHY.SUBTITLE: Buying local is not just about supporting national industry — it's concrete operational and economic advantages over imported equipment.
WHY.CARD1_DESC: Buying from a Panamanian manufacturer means no duties, no ITBMS on international freight, no customs nationalization costs.
WHY.CARD2_DESC: Mixers in stock ready to deliver. No 60-90 day waits for shipping containers or customs delays.
WHY.CARD3_TITLE: Technical support in Spanish, in real time
WHY.CARD3_DESC: We talk directly, on Panama time, no call centers or foreign-language tickets. Quick diagnosis via WhatsApp or on-site visit.
WHY.CARD4_DESC: Complete parts inventory in Pacora. Your mixer doesn't go out of service waiting for parts that never arrive.

PRODUCTS.TITLE: Two models designed for Panama's construction reality
PRODUCTS.SUBTITLE: From residential projects and remodels to large-scale commercial works. Pick the model based on volume and demand of the work.
PRODUCTS.MT370_DESC: Ideal for residential projects, remodels and small commercial works. Balance between capacity, transport and consumption.
PRODUCTS.MT480_DESC: Designed for major commercial works, public infrastructure and contractors with high daily mixing load.

COVERAGE.TITLE: Delivery and support across all 10 provinces
COVERAGE.SUBTITLE: We serve contractors and construction firms throughout the country. We coordinate direct delivery or factory pickup based on your location and preference.
COVERAGE.NOTE: We also serve customers in the comarcas and remote areas — we coordinate transport based on your location.

FAQ.TITLE: Frequently asked questions from Panama customers
FAQ.Q1: Do you have mixers available in stock?
FAQ.A1: Yes, we maintain active inventory of MT-370 and MT-480 models at our Pacora facilities. Availability may vary by demand — confirm current availability when requesting your quote.
FAQ.Q2: Do you deliver or do I have to pick up at the factory?
FAQ.A2: Both options are available. We coordinate direct delivery to your jobsite in any province, or you can pick up at our Pacora plant. Transport cost is calculated by distance.
FAQ.Q3: How does the warranty and technical support process work?
FAQ.A3: Every mixer includes a 6-month warranty against manufacturing defects. For technical support contact our team in Pacora — we respond via WhatsApp, call, or on-site visit depending on the case.
FAQ.Q4: Do you have parts for mixers bought years ago?
FAQ.A4: Yes. We maintain parts inventory for all MT-370 and MT-480 models, including units sold years ago. Main components (engine, transmission, drum) are always available.
FAQ.Q5: Do you accept local bank transfer payments?
FAQ.A5: Yes. We accept transfers to Panamanian bank accounts (no international transfer cost), cash, and other arrangeable methods. We issue tax invoices with ITBMS breakdown.
